preconditions.description: The number of files to be deleted m is between 1 and the total number of files n, both inclusive, and both are between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each index a_i in the list of indices a is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The list of indices a contains exactly m distinct elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(filename) <= 100 for filename in filenames)
preconditions.description: Each filename in the list of filenames has a length between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(filename.islower() or filename.isdigit() or filename == '.' for char in filename for filename in filenames)
preconditions.description: Each character in each filename is a lowercase English letter, a digit, or a dot.
The number of filenames is exactly n.

postconditions.description: The output starts with 'Yes\n' followed by a pattern if a valid pattern exists, or it is exactly 'No' if no such pattern exists.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('Yes\n') == any(all(pattern[i] == '?' or pattern[i] == filenames[a_i-1][i] for i in range(len(pattern))) for a_i in a) if stdout.startswith('Yes\n') else True
postconditions.description: If the output starts with 'Yes\n', the pattern matches all files to be deleted and only them.
